llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Kia Access MCP setup guide with sensitive vehicle and account capabilities, but its risks are purpose-aligned and clearly gated by user confirmation.

dimensions.detail: Access to Kia credentials, location, and real vehicle commands is high impact, but proportionate to the requested Kia Access integration and configurable through KIA_WRITE_MODE.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses an MCP config entry that runs the external npm package via npx and stores Kia credentials in environment variables; this is disclosed setup behavior, but users should trust the package source before installing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions repeatedly require explicit user confirmation for writes, caution against retries and secret echoing, and describe read staleness and command-result limitations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses a locally stored remember-me token that can refresh sessions without MFA and provides a confirmation-gated forget-session tool; users should treat exported refresh tokens as full account bypass material.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is to let a user query and command their own Kia vehicle; the listed capabilities match that purpose, including status, location, charging, climate, and optional door lock/unlock commands.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable giving an MCP server your Kia account credentials and vehicle control. Prefer KIA_WRITE_MODE=none for read-only use, use all only when door lock/unlock control is necessary, and never share exported refresh tokens.
llm.findings: [AS2] expected: The flagged mcp.json reference is a user-facing setup instruction for adding this MCP server, not evidence that the skill reads or abuses existing MCP configuration files.
